ledger_ref.description: move the efifb kick to just before fbdev registration

snapshot.path: parent tree is the m-052 tree, not a new archived snapshot

semantics.summary: One existing call moves from dev_rsrc_init to just before drm_fb_helper_initial_config. The nulldisplay gate stays. On 6.12 the kick is aperture_remove_all_conflicting_devices over 0..-1 plus sysfb_disable(NULL); the name argument is not a selector. Registering the new fb first would leave it at fb1. A dummy-free handoff that still occupies fb0 needs a new console state, which this patch does not add. If initial_config fails after the kick, the console stays on the dummy device; a failure before the kick still leaves efifb. The kick now happens after dr_mtrr_setup. The known WC/uncached-minus line is not proven to be caused by efifb, so a wedge or a failed modeset puts the call back.
